we have shown how the tracking-by-detection framework can be significantly improved by exploiting low-level image information in a joint tracking and segmentation framework.

The main takeaway from our work is that
tracking-by-detection is not the only way to go: by incorporating more low level information into the tracking process we are able to improve the state-of-the-art in multiple target tracking.
a joint tracking and segmentation approach is able to exploit more information and is therefore able to better deal with occlusions and other challenging situations.
the segmentation of targets and background is an integral part of multi-target tracking and should not be considered as a separate task.
